propositions: Mapping configuration is currently hardcoded in adapters/jira_family and must be extracted into a provider-neutral config-driven foundation with schema, layered merge, and capability descriptor
The [tool.rebar.mapping] section must be registered as a reserved section so it is parsed raw and not coerced through JiraConfig or warned as unknown

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key with precedence: project-specific overrides default overrides built-in, while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale at the most-specific layer

Configuration validation must fail closed offline against effective vocabulary: every axis-map value must exist in its declared vocabulary, only the 'skip' sentinel is permitted as non-vocabulary axis-map value, and malformed blocks raise MappingConfigError
A Capability descriptor dataclass must declare which mapping axes the target supports (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) to gate axis configuration
The mapping_config module must import nothing from jira adapters and contain no Jira-specific literals to maintain provider neutrality while allowing adapters to inject defaults
